notes:
This release adds a full desktop refactor:

CHANGED
- Aggregate all stores: Overview, Lens, Stats and Nexus now operate across every store in ~/.timps/memory/<hash>/.
- Lens is now memory search: debounced full-text search across all stores with highlighting, tags, scores and store chips.
- Stats rewritten: aggregate breakdown with per-store table and a no-data empty state.
- Nexus simplified: static whole-graph view, no physics loop, no polling, manual refresh.
- Settings cleaned up: removed AI Provider and Server URL sections, project path selection removed.

ADDED
- Memory view: file/folder browser over ~/.timps with sizes and a content preview pane.
- Connectors guided setup: open developer console, register callback, paste client_id/client_secret inline.

FIXED
- Fixed-port OAuth listener (binds 127.0.0.1:12849 first, falls back to ephemeral port).
- Fixed latent trim_label panic on multi-byte characters in the Nexus graph.

See the changelog for the full list.
